competencyFramework.name: Franklin's 9 Transdisciplinary Competencies
competencyFramework.description: Canonical definitions from Franklin's TD Competencies Rubric (2026). Used across grading, narratives, council reviews, and transition reports.

competencies.name: Collaboration
competencies.description: Works productively and respectfully with others to achieve shared goals

competencies.name: Storytelling / Communication
competencies.description: Communicates ideas clearly, creatively, and appropriately for audience and purpose

competencies.name: Reflexivity
competencies.description: Reflects critically on learning, decisions, and assumptions

competencies.name: Empathy / Perspective Taking
competencies.description: Demonstrates understanding and respect for others' perspectives and experiences

competencies.name: Knowledge-Based Reasoning
competencies.description: Applies disciplinary and interdisciplinary knowledge to solve problems

competencies.name: Futures Thinking
competencies.description: Envisions and prepares for multiple and preferred futures

competencies.name: Systems Thinking
competencies.description: Identifies and understands interconnections within and across systems

competencies.name: Adaptability
competencies.description: Responds constructively to change and ambiguity

competencies.name: Agency
competencies.description: Takes initiative and ownership of learning and actions
